item.title: CodeGPT
item.description: CodeGPT is an IDE extension that adds AI chat, autocomplete, and agent workflows to VS Code and JetBrains IDEs, with a bring-your-own-key model that lets you connect the provider and model of your choice rather than routing through a single fixed backend.

item.title: Blackbox AI
item.description: Blackbox AI is a multi-model coding assistant that works both as a standalone web chat and as an extension across more than 30 IDEs, giving developers code search, autocomplete, image-to-code, and agentic app-building from a single account.
